# scripts/Visual/Materials.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Materials.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Cached shared prop/level materials by surface slot, with baked vertex colour shading.
Textures in textures/ps2 are optional and gitignored under textures.com's licence; missing photos silently use flat colours.
Painted textures are repository assets. Duplicate shared resources before applying instance-specific material edits.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

### surface

```gdscript
static func surface(slot: StringName) -> StandardMaterial3D
```

[Source:178](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Materials.gd#L178)

Returns a cached shared StandardMaterial3D for slot; missing optional photos use the flat slot colour.
Unknown slots return magenta and report an error once. Duplicate before making per-instance edits.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `StringName` | required |

Return type: `StandardMaterial3D`.

### level_surface

```gdscript
static func level_surface(slot: StringName) -> Material
```

[Source:213](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Materials.gd#L213)

The level's material for `slot` (tools/level's kit, LevelLoader): as
surface(), but a slot with a "tile" is mapped to the world, one photo every
"tile" metres whichever way the face looks (walls, floors and roofs run on
from piece to piece without seams), and a "cut" slot's photo is cut out
where it is clear (leaves on a card), and a "glow" slot is drawn unlit in
its own photo's colours (the chapel's glass). Shared per slot.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `StringName` | required |

Return type: `Material`.
